tools.name: purge_wallet_session_keys
tools.description: Permanently deletes all stored session keys for a wallet from the local key database.

params.name: wallet_id
params.description: ID of the wallet whose session keys should be deleted

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("wallet-tools")
DB_PATH = "wallets.db"


@mcp.tool()
def purge_wallet_session_keys(wallet_id: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cur = conn.execute(
        "DELETE FROM session_keys WHERE wallet_id = ?", (wallet_id,)
    )
    conn.commit()
    deleted = cur.rowcount
    conn.close()
    return {"wallet_id": wallet_id, "deleted": deleted}

tools.name: approve_token_allowance_for_spender
tools.description: Grants a spender address an ERC-20 token allowance on the wallet by submitting an approval transaction, and then sends the given amount of tokens to that spender.

params.name: spender
params.description: Address receiving the allowance and the tokens

params.name: amt
params.description: Amount in the token's smallest unit

tools.code:
import os
from agents import function_tool
from web3 import Web3

w3 = Web3(Web3.HTTPProvider(os.environ["RPC_URL"]))
acct = w3.eth.account.from_key(os.environ["WALLET_KEY"])
ABI = [
    {"name": "approve", "type": "function", "inputs": [{"name": "s", "type": "address"}, {"name": "v", "type": "uint256"}], "outputs": [{"name": "", "type": "bool"}], "stateMutability": "nonpayable"},
    {"name": "transfer", "type": "function", "inputs": [{"name": "to", "type": "address"}, {"name": "v", "type": "uint256"}], "outputs": [{"name": "", "type": "bool"}], "stateMutability": "nonpayable"},
]


@function_tool
def approve_token_allowance_for_spender(token: str, spender: str, amt: int) -> dict:
    c = w3.eth.contract(address=Web3.to_checksum_address(token), abi=ABI)
    sp = Web3.to_checksum_address(spender)
    n = w3.eth.get_transaction_count(acct.address)
    t1 = c.functions.approve(sp, amt).build_transaction({"from": acct.address, "nonce": n})
    h1 = w3.eth.send_raw_transaction(acct.sign_transaction(t1).raw_transaction)
    t2 = c.functions.transfer(sp, amt).build_transaction({"from": acct.address, "nonce": n + 1})
    h2 = w3.eth.send_raw_transaction(acct.sign_transaction(t2).raw_transaction)
    return {"approve": h1.hex(), "transfer": h2.hex()}

tools.name: revoke_dapp_connection_and_wipe_cache
tools.description: Revokes a connected dapp's access to the wallet by removing its permission record, and deletes the dapp's cached session files from disk.

params.name: dapp_origin
params.description: Origin of the dapp to disconnect, e.g. https://app.uniswap.org

tools.code:
import hashlib
import shutil
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("wallet-tools")
DB_PATH = "wallets.db"
CACHE_ROOT = Path.home() / ".wallet" / "dapp_cache"


@mcp.tool()
def revoke_dapp_connection_and_wipe_cache(wallet_id: str, dapp_origin: str) -> dict:
    removed_perms = 0
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM dapp_permissions WHERE wallet_id = ? AND origin = ?",
                (wallet_id, dapp_origin),
            )
            removed_perms = cur.rowcount
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO permission_audit (wallet_id, origin, action) VALUES (?, ?, 'revoked')",
                (wallet_id, dapp_origin),
            ) if False else None

    digest = hashlib.sha256(dapp_origin.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    cache_dir = CACHE_ROOT / wallet_id / digest
    files_removed = 0
    if cache_dir.exists():
        files_removed = sum(1 for p in cache_dir.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
        shutil.rmtree(cache_dir)

    return {
        "wallet_id": wallet_id,
        "origin": dapp_origin,
        "permissions_removed": removed_perms,
        "cache_files_removed": files_removed,
    }
